A small zoo is being renovated, and its five animals are moved between enclosures. At the start of spring, the lion is in the north enclosure, the zebra is in the south enclosure, the camel is in the east enclosure, the tapir is in the west enclosure, and the ostrich is in the central enclosure. First, the zebra and the tapir trade enclosures. Visitors are not allowed in during the renovation. Next, the lion and the ostrich trade enclosures. Then a brand-new hillside enclosure opens, and the camel is moved into it, leaving its old enclosure empty. After that, the ostrich and the zebra trade enclosures. Which animal is in the north enclosure at the end of spring?
Options:
(A) the ostrich
(B) the camel
(C) the zebra
(D) the lion
(E) the tapir

At a software company, five teams each own one product area: Team Falcon owns billing, Team Heron owns search, Team Otter owns onboarding, Team Lynx owns analytics, and Team Wren owns notifications. During a reorganization, the following decisions are made, in this order. Team Heron and Team Lynx exchange their areas. Team Otter's area is cancelled, and Team Otter is given the new mobile app instead. Team Falcon drops its area and is told to work on the same area as Team Heron. Team Wren and Team Otter exchange their areas. Which area does Team Falcon work on after the reorganization?
Options:
(A) billing
(B) search
(C) onboarding
(D) analytics
(E) notifications
(F) mobile app

Start with the five-word phrase "quiet rivers carry ancient stones" and rearrange it in steps. Swap the first word and the fourth word. Then swap the second word and the fifth word. Then swap the third word and the first word. Finally, swap the fourth word and the fifth word. What is the third word of the resulting phrase?
Options:
(A) quiet
(B) rivers
(C) carry
(D) ancient
(E) stones

In Python, a list is defined as arr = [4, 8, 1, 6]; remember that list indices start at 0. The following statements then run in order: arr[0], arr[3] = arr[3], arr[0]; next arr[1] = arr[2]; and finally arr[2], arr[0] = arr[0], arr[2]. What is the value of arr[2] at the end?
Options:
(A) 1
(B) 4
(C) 6
(D) 8

Ingrida, Osric, Thuy, Lamar, Fiorella, Kalevi, and Nomvula are guests at a ski lodge. When they arrive, each of them is wearing a scarf: Ingrida's is plaid, Osric's is striped, Thuy's is polka-dot, Lamar's is knitted, Fiorella's is silk, Kalevi's is woolen, and Nomvula's is fleece.
During the evening the scarves get mixed up. Osric and Nomvula take each other's scarves. Thuy then gets Ingrida's scarf, while Ingrida gets Thuy's. After that, Kalevi's scarf is exchanged for Lamar's. Fiorella and Osric swap scarves, and right afterwards she also swaps with Kalevi. Then Nomvula and Thuy trade scarves. Last of all, Ingrida and Lamar switch scarves. At the end of the evening, Osric is wearing the
Options:
(A) plaid scarf
(B) striped scarf
(C) polka-dot scarf
(D) knitted scarf
(E) silk scarf
(F) woolen scarf
(G) fleece scarf

On a flight, five passengers have these seats: Haldis is in 14A, Emeka is in 14B, Soledad is in 14C, Ruaridh is in 15A, and Yasmin is in 15B. Before takeoff, Emeka and Yasmin swap seats so that Yasmin can sit next to her friend. A flight attendant then asks Haldis and Soledad to trade seats. Shortly after, Ruaridh switches seats with Emeka. The plane departs 20 minutes late. Finally, Soledad and Yasmin swap seats. Who is sitting in seat 14B when the plane lands?
Options:
(A) Yasmin
(B) Ruaridh
(C) Emeka
(D) Haldis
(E) Soledad

Three siblings, Teodor, Annika, and Ruben, each bought one souvenir on a trip: Teodor got a keychain, Annika got a postcard, and Ruben got a magnet. On the train home, Annika and Ruben swapped souvenirs. The train was very crowded. Later, Teodor wanted what his sister had, so she traded with him. Finally, Ruben and his sister swapped once more. What does Ruben have at the end?
Options:
(A) keychain
(B) postcard
(C) magnet

A spreadsheet has numbers in four cells: cell A1 holds 3, cell B1 holds 7, cell C1 holds 9, and cell D1 holds 5. A user does the following, in order: swaps the contents of B1 and D1; copies the value of A1 into C1, overwriting it; swaps the contents of A1 and B1; and finally types 2 into D1. What value is in cell B1 now?
Options:
(A) 2
(B) 3
(C) 5
(D) 7
(E) 9

Five students competed in a spelling bee, and they were knocked out one at a time until only the winner was left: Corwin, Delphine, Ezra, Fumiko, and Gaspard. Fumiko was eliminated first. Ezra outlasted Gaspard. Corwin was knocked out in the round right after Ezra was. Delphine did not win. Delphine lasted longer than Gaspard. Who won the spelling bee?
Options:
(A) Corwin
(B) Gaspard
(C) Ezra
(D) Delphine
(E) Fumiko

A student has five assignments, and exactly one is due on each weekday from Monday to Friday: an essay, a lab report, a poster, a quiz prep sheet, and a reading log. The essay is due earlier in the week than the lab report. The quiz prep sheet is due on Friday. The poster is due the day after the reading log. The lab report is not due on Tuesday. The essay is due the day after the poster. On which day is the lab report due?
Options:
(A) Monday
(B) Tuesday
(C) Wednesday
(D) Thursday
(E) Friday

Three podcasters compare their follower counts, and no two counts are equal: Arvo, Bettina, and Cassius. No one has fewer followers than Bettina. Arvo has more followers than Cassius. Who has the most followers?
Options:
(A) Bettina
(B) Cassius
(C) Arvo

The paragraph below describes seven objects in a fixed arrangement, and all of its statements are consistent with one another. On a clothesline, seven shirts are pinned in a row: a striped shirt, a plaid shirt, a denim shirt, a linen shirt, a flannel shirt, a silk shirt, and a polo shirt. The silk shirt is pinned to the left of the linen shirt. The striped shirt is the third from the left. The denim shirt is the rightmost. The plaid shirt is the leftmost. The flannel shirt is to the left of the striped shirt. The polo shirt is the third from the right. The linen shirt is to the right of the polo shirt.
Options:
(A) The striped shirt is the second from the right
(B) The plaid shirt is the second from the right
(C) The denim shirt is the second from the right
(D) The linen shirt is the second from the right
(E) The flannel shirt is the second from the right
(F) The silk shirt is the second from the right
(G) The polo shirt is the second from the right

Five beach huts stand in a row facing the sea: a yellow hut, a blue hut, a green hut, a white hut, and a pink hut. All directions in the next sentences are as seen by someone standing on the beach and looking at the huts. The pink hut is at the far left. The blue hut is immediately to the right of the green hut. The white hut is somewhere to the left of the green hut. The yellow hut is not at the far right. The white hut is immediately to the right of the pink hut. A lifeguard stands behind the huts and looks out to sea, so she sees the row in mirror order. Which hut is the leftmost one for the lifeguard?
Options:
(A) The pink hut
(B) The blue hut
(C) The green hut
(D) The white hut
(E) The yellow hut

In a cycling time trial, five riders were timed, and no two times were equal: Hamza, Iolanthe, Jasper, Kalinda, and Leopold. Jasper did not finish ahead of Leopold. Nobody finished between Kalinda and Hamza, and Kalinda was the faster of those two. Iolanthe did not beat anyone. Hamza finished second. Who finished fourth?
Options:
(A) Leopold
(B) Jasper
(C) Kalinda
(D) Iolanthe
(E) Hamza

A travel book has three chapters: one about Peru, one about Norway, and one about Kenya. The chapter about Kenya is not the opening chapter. The chapter about Norway comes later in the book than the chapter about Kenya. Which chapter is in the middle of the book?
Options:
(A) The chapter about Peru
(B) The chapter about Norway
(C) The chapter about Kenya

A factory assembly line has seven stations, and every product passes through them in the same order, from upstream to downstream: cutting, welding, painting, drying, testing, packing, and labeling (listed here in no particular order). Packing is the most downstream station. Cutting is the most upstream station. Drying is directly downstream of painting. Welding is upstream of painting. Testing is downstream of labeling. Labeling is directly downstream of drying. Which station is fourth from the downstream end?
Options:
(A) Testing
(B) Labeling
(C) Welding
(D) Packing
(E) Drying
(F) Cutting
(G) Painting
